questions: When a price goes up or down, do you want to change it on the list, and should the old price be kept so you can see what it used to be?
Do some things come in different sizes or ways of selling (for example a single sachet and a full box), each with its own price?
When you look up a price, will you type the full name exactly, or do you want to type part of a name (like "milk") and see everything that matches?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
